sloka: ततः पार्श्वे ऽतिविपुला ददर्श महतीं शिलाम् ।तरसा तां समुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप बलवद्बली ।तां शरैर्दशभिः क्रुद्धस्ताडयामास राक्षसः ।। ५.४४.११।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ pārśve 'tivipulā dadarśa mahatīṁ śilām ।tarasā tāṁ samutpāṭya cikṣepa balavadbalī ।tāṁ śarairdaśabhiḥ kruddhastāḍayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ ।। 5.44.11।।।।

translations.english: Powerful Hanuman with all vehemence lifted the rock and hurled it at the giant which he angrily smashed with ten arrows.
